comment: Single source of truth for the semi-digital chi2 calibration coefficients.
Written by energy_reconstruction_Tminuit/EnergyReco.C and read by sdhcal.calib,
so the C++ and the Python reconstructions can no longer drift apart.
The values below are the ones recovered from the internship code. They are
flagged fitted_on_train_split=false because the original fit used every event
and then drew its linearity and resolution curves on those same events; rerun
EnergyReco.C to replace them with coefficients fitted on the training split only.
